name: Revise a trip shortlist as priorities change
property_tested: Hard constraints; instruction supersession over multiple turns

turns.prompt: Which three-night stays in {WORKSPACE}/hotels.json cost at most $360 including fees and have step-free access? Reply with a JSON array of every matching hotel ID.
Breakfast needs to be included too. Update the shortlist in your reply.
I can spend $400 now. Keep my other requirements and reply with the updated array.
The higher budget was a mistake. We're back to $360. Give me the final array.

complexity.notes: Authored depth estimates count dependent reasoning/action stages, not tool calls. Fault count counts adverse episodes, including supplied bad data and context loss; fixtures and user revisions alone are excluded. Input files count distinct fixture paths.
